Examples off the top of my head as to how a poorly done barrier could make the situation worse.

Maybe it is constructed at the wrong height and as a result would increase the likelihood of a car that strikes it in a crash flipping.

Maybe the angle is such that it has a greater likelihood of directing the crashed vehicle back into traffic and causing a secondary crash.

Maybe the barrier is made of a material that could splinter/shatter/puncture or otherwise fail as to become a direct threat to the individuals in the car that is crashing.
